seedDataPosture.content: A committed lowdb document holding synthetic users, contacts, bank accounts, transactions, likes, comments and notifications. The records carry person-shaped fields (names, usernames, e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, avatar URLs) and bcrypt password hashes.
seedDataPosture.provenance: Generated upstream by faker 5.5.3 via scripts/generateSeedData.ts and scripts/seedDataUtils.ts; the generator and its .env-driven volume knobs are both committed.
seedDataPosture.position: This is synthetic fixture data, not personal data about real people. No seed record, username, e-mail address, telephone number, or password hash is reproduced in any Versionless evidence file, and none may be introduced by later work.
seedDataPosture.unknownPreserved: Faker output is synthetic by construction; this record does not audit every one of the seeded records individually.
